{{Top|leg}}
A '''crime syndicate''' consisting of members of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] operated on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The group was composed of bungling, overconfident, small-time hoods who wished to make a name for themselves.<ref name="id">{{WEGCite|story=A Case of Mistaken Identities|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the crime syndicate was after an important merchantize that would be delivered by [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|a courier]]. However they ran afoul of a group of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents who were on a mission to Bothawui, whose [[Unidentified courier lookalike|a member]] was a lookalike to that courier.<ref name="id" />

Spotting the group in a business district (who had fell victim to another misunderstanding), they ambushed them with three [[limousine/Legends|limo-speeders]], armed with hold-out [[blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknives]], attempting to force them off the road. The [[Unidentified Bothan cabby|cabby]] who carried them to [[Bothan hotel|their hotel]], took them to back streets, across wide plaza strips, a park, and pedestrian walkways.<ref name="id" />

Eventually they confronted the Rebels, demanding the merchantise from the courier; they even doubled the offer, but threatening that they won't wait more than a day. They ignored any excuses the Rebel operatives tried to explain.<ref name="id" />

Around the same time, they had a feud with a groupd of individuals, and learning that they had been hired to [[hunting/Legends|hunt]] in the northern glaciers of the planet, they found an opportunity to capture them. After an attack by a [[ganjuko]], the hunters sent a distress call. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] of the syndicate eliminated the rescue crew and flew to the camp with a [[snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]; once the hatch opened and the hunters approached the ship, the bounty hunters attacked them, using nets and stun weapons, with orders to capture them alive.<ref name="hunt">{{WEGCite|story=A Most Deadly Hunt|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

However during the fight, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] joined the attack, ruining their attempt. A [[combat snowspeer]] from the valley hovered at the edge of the glacer shooting at the camp, while Imperials on [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsor]] skis and sleds came shooting at them. Both the bounty hunters and their bounties attempted to escape on the speeder, but being pursued by the Imperials, they crashed near the [[Luxury hunting lodge]].<ref name="hunt" />

{{Stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The story setup explains that the initial speeder chase would be non-lethal, as neither side wished to draw attention. However the players could evade them or fight well to force them to back down; knowing that they can always return with more firepower, the thugs encounter them at the [[Bothan hotel]], a Sullustan covered by several Rodians around.
